Subject: Apogee Health — Post-discovery technical deep-dive

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the discovery session today — we walked through the initial scope and the team is excited to evaluate Redwood for inference in our clinical docs pipeline. The stakeholders we plan to bring to the technical deep-dive are: myself (platform/product), Jon Park (SRE), and Maya Singh (security/compliance).

Primary goals for the session:
- Validate real-time latency targets for 512-token average requests
- Discuss data retention and key management (KMS/HSM options)
- Walk through deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC) and network topology needs

Can you propose 2–3 60–90 minute windows next week that include an SE and an SRE-level engineer? We'd like a run-through of the architecture tradeoffs and a quick Q&A runway for our security questions.

Prefer mornings PT.

Thanks,
Elena

elena@apogeehealth.com
